about: Every measured number the brain uses, with provenance (V2_STRATEGY.md rule 1, DEV_WORKFLOW.md). Runtime quantities (table plane, can size, palm-to-can offset, tracking baseline) are measured per order and logged, never stored here. Frames: pelvis = x ahead, y left, z up, metres; forearm = along the wrist-roll axis.

palm_real_m.method: g1-fetch ee_offset_x 0.15 (URDF wrist-roll origin to the model palm) + 0.096 from jog_x.py step 4 chosen by the owner's eye (hand beside the can, 2 cm steps); re-measured 2026-10-21 as -0.097

palm_half_height_m.method: assumed from the BrainCo hand's palm width; the pinky edge sat at the table on trial 8 (dz -0.02) with no harm. MEASURE with the tape

grasp_below_mid_m.method: palm centre below the can mid-height: trial 8 at -0.02 was the deepest wrap, trials 5-7 at +0.03/+0.01/0 held; V2_STRATEGY.md section 5

palm_to_axis_m.method: the palm point r + this from the can axis at the closure pose. 2026-10-23 grasps 1-2 (runs 20261024T034032, --model-grasp, 66 mm can at (0.40, 0.19)): both approaches pushed the can (1.8 and 1.5 cm) from a model gap of 2.3-2.5 cm on, the thumb placed first (C922 cam3_slide.jpg); the palm point (calib palm_real_m) sits about 4 cm ahead of the palm centre (teach-3), so the hand meets the can about 2.5 cm sooner than r + 1 cm. Was 0.01 (g1-fetch grab_can, the Oct 19 holds with a contact-stop slide). geom.plan_reach now takes it as axis_off (was a literal 0.01)

pregrasp_standoff_m.method: V2_STRATEGY.md section 5 (v1 used 0.05 with a blind slide; the servo frame needs the hand near the can)

can_diameters_m.method: slim / standard, classified from the box width at the box depth with a 60 mm threshold (73 mm measured for a 66 mm can)

torso_bands.method: torso_link.STL, waist_support_link.STL, pelvis.STL vertex extents per height band, placed by the g1_body23.urdf joints (stdlib STL reader)

clearance_m.frame: segment centre lines to the torso bands: lower upper arm, forearm, hand (wrist to fingertips), hand to the right arm
clearance_m.method: V2_STRATEGY.md section 3 (lower upper arm 3, forearm 4, hand 6, right arm 5 cm on the segment centre lines to the torso bands); replay_reach.py: the planner's chosen poses keep the upper arm 4.4-10.6 cm clear on the 18 logged positions

pitch_max_deg.method: V2_STRATEGY.md section 3: beyond 15 deg of droop the real palm drops 1-2 cm below the level-forearm assumption

ik_tol_m.method: V2_STRATEGY.md: the hard-yaw IK either solves or not; v1's 0.035 accepted a full can radius of error

lift_m.method: owner 2026-10-23: after the grasp the arm raises the can much higher (was 0.06, the v1 lift: 6 cm with correction reached within 3-7 mm on every grasp). 12 cm clears the table visibly; grasp 5 lifted 6 cm within 4 mm (1 correction round)

offer_delta_m.method: owner 2026-10-23: after the grasp the arm raises the can much higher and extends it forward, obvious and easy to take (was [-0.12, 0.03, 0.06], the v1 offer; then [0.08, 0, 0.22] from a 6 cm lift). From grasp 5's closure palm (0.388, 0.206, 0.104) with lift_m 0.12: palm about (0.448, 0.206, 0.464), 45 cm ahead of the hips, 1.30 m above the floor; IK solves at psi 5, pitch -38, clearances 8.4 / 14.7 cm. Above the head camera's view: offer_pose falls back to this base pose; the release comes from the tug, the let-go words or the r key

camera_pose.frame: pelvis: x, y, z of the D435 link and its pitch down
camera_pose.method: g1_body23.urdf d435_joint (0.0576, 0.0175, 0.41987 from torso_link, rpy 0 0.8308 0) + torso_link at (-0.004, 0, 0.054)

pelvis_height_m.method: g1-fetch floor_height 0.98 m for a can point at z 0.14 (2026-10-21 logs)

contact_rise_rad.frame: joint tracking error above the per-pose baseline
contact_rise_rad.method: v1 contact stop; in v2 a safety abort only (fired once wrongly 6.6 cm from the can, live7.log)

hold_signature.frame: BrainCo finger q: thumb below, fingers between
hold_signature.method: 12 holds: thumb 0.07-0.22, at least three fingers 0.41-0.61 (V2_STRATEGY.md section 5)

hand_feature_K.frame: hand feature offsets from the can axis along (forearm d, palm normal n, z): fingertip front, nearest face, median height
hand_feature_K.method: NOT MEASURED: step 1 of the v2 plan (the kill test). Measure at the ALIGNED PRE-GRASP (palm centred on the can in d and z by the owner's eye, the standoff along n): the servo compares like with like there; at the closure pose the can hides part of the hand from the head camera (mock: the front feature shifts 0.9 cm). Until then the brain measures and logs the offsets but does not servo

table_clear_m.frame: palm lowest point (palm z - palm_half_height_m) above the table plane
table_clear_m.method: the memo asks for +0.01, but with grasp z = table + h/2 - 0.015 and a 4.5 cm palm half-height the pinky edge of a 12-13.5 cm can ends 0-0.8 cm above the table; trial 8 (2026-10-19, the deepest wrap) had it at the table with no harm. -0.01 allows touching; MEASURE the palm half-height with the tape to settle it

high_rise_m.method: the high waypoint of every v1 pick (raise, reach high, lower), 2026-10-19/21

raise_ahead_m.frame: pelvis x ahead of the home palm
raise_ahead_m.method: v1 'up' waypoint (home x + 5 cm), every pick 2026-10-19/21

raise_side_y_m.frame: pelvis y, the least leftward y of the raise
raise_side_y_m.method: the raise goes up beside the body; v1 raised at the pre-grasp y (0.16-0.26 on the logged picks); 0.18 keeps the hand clear of the chest for right-of-centre plans (mock)

retreat_out_m.frame: along -n (away from the can) before the retreat up

lift_rise_tol_m.frame: the can's rise in the head frame vs lift_m
lift_rise_tol_m.method: V2_STRATEGY.md section 5 (YOLOE points repeat within 7 mm, live4.log)

offer_search_m.frame: largest shift of the offer pose ahead, toward the midline, up, searched in 5 / 5 / 4 cm steps until the palm is in the head camera's view
offer_search_m.method: V2_STRATEGY.md section 5 (offer inside the view); mock: in view at (+0.05, -0.10, 0) to (0, -0.10, 0)

fingertip_m.frame: open fingertips ahead of the palm centre

cluster_radius_m.frame: around the held can: new depth points within it count as the guest's hand

near_ahead_m.frame: pelvis x: nothing within it at chest height (z 0.15-0.50, |y| < 0.12) moves the arm
near_ahead_m.method: the hard safety kept from v1 (ROBOT_RULES.md, Oct 19)

speed_scale.frame: multiplies every Cartesian speed (raise 0.10, high 0.08, lower 0.05, corrections 0.04, approach steps 0.05 m/s) and the joint step per streamed target (joint_step_rad); in (0, 1]
speed_scale.method: the speeds of every v1 pick (2026-10-19/21, n 14) at 1.0; a run with another value logs a deviation

table_edge_m.frame: pelvis x of the table's near edge (the chest front is at x 0.08: tape the chest-to-edge distance and add 0.08)
table_edge_m.method: NOT MEASURED: the owner's tape, passed as --table-edge (a logged deviation) until it is written here. Required before the arm is enabled (V2_REVIEW round 2): every raise, retreat, home and park path whose hand passes within 2 cm of the edge below the table top + 3 cm is refused before it moves

joint_step_rad.frame: largest change of any left-arm joint in one streamed 20 ms target, at speed_scale 1 (scaled by it)
joint_step_rad.method: V2_REVIEW round 2 blocker 1 (a 0.59 rad wrist-roll snap in one target): 0.02 rad = 1 rad/s, under g1-fetch's streamer clip max_joint_vel 1.2 rad/s (0.024 per tick, configs/default.yaml, read 2026-10-20), so the streamed command equals the target; the 2d4f1ca raise rolled at most 0.016 rad per target

table_floor_margin_m.frame: palm lowest point above the fitted table plane: no goal or command puts the palm centre below plane + palm_half_height_m + this
table_floor_margin_m.method: V2_REVIEW round 2 blocker 4 (correction rounds drove the command 1.7-7.9 cm into the table with the plane 5-20 mm low); 5 mm raises the 12.2 cm can's grasp by 4 mm (palm bottom 1 mm above the table as planned)

pre_rest_tol_m.frame: measured palm z above the commanded stop 2 cm over a goal near the table floor (motion.Arm.goto); more is a hand resting on something
pre_rest_tol_m.method: 2026-10-23 grasp 1 (spikes/2026-10-23-v2-grasp, runs 20261024T033336): the hand settled 7 mm above the stop with nothing under it (C922 cam3_pregrasp.jpg); the stop line fed forward the 3.3 cm sag measured at high and the arm sagged less lower down; corr_tol 6 mm refused it as contact. 15 mm sits above that sag error; an object under the hand between the stop and 15 mm above it is stopped by the final line's follow watch (contact_lag 6 mm): test_motion test_stop_rest_tolerates_the_sag_error_not_an_object
pre_rest_tol_m.pose: pre-grasp beside a 66 mm can at (0.40, 0.19), psi -10, half speed

visual_gap_agree_m.frame: visual near-face gap vs the model gap along the palm normal
visual_gap_agree_m.method: V2_REVIEW round 2 must-fix: the hand closes only on a visual gap that agrees with the model within about 1 cm (the larger of the two counts); the 1.5 cm band with the smaller one closed 1.6-2.4 cm short in the mock

raise_back_m.frame: pelvis x behind the home palm: the raise first goes up there to the table top + 3 cm, then to the raise waypoint
raise_back_m.method: V2_REVIEW round 3: the straight raise swept a 12.5 cm hand's fingertips to x 0.347-0.349 under the table top (keep-out reach 0.351 at fingertip 0.125); this waypoint keeps them behind x 0.304-0.306 (mock, eight plan targets, clearances >= 5.6 cm); 0.04 hits the elbow's joint margin at two air targets

hand_back_m.frame: the open hand behind the palm centre along the wrist-roll axis (the table floor's hand box)
hand_back_m.method: assumed: the mock's hand box; BrainCo left hand 15.9 cm long with the palm centre about 4.5 cm from its wrist end (URDF extents). Tape with fingertip_m

hand_half_thickness_m.frame: half the open hand's thickness, palm face to back (the table floor's hand box)
hand_half_thickness_m.method: assumed: BrainCo palm 7.6 x 4.1 cm (URDF extents); the owner tapes the hand thickness (the run plan)
